description:
Amendment 0001:

This Amendment 0001 serves to inform all prospective quoters that the closing date for the subject solicitation has been extended from April 14, 2026, 1630 hrs to April 30, 2026, 1630 hrs.

This change is issued via SF-30 Amendment No. 0001, attached to this notice.

Quoters must acknowledge this amendment by submitting a signed SF-30 with their quotation. Failure to do so may result in the offer being considered non-responsive.

All other terms and conditions remain unchanged
